name: expense-api

dependencies.name: exchangerate-api
dependencies.description: Looks up the historical FX rate for the expense's paid currency and date to convert it into the household's home currency (USD) for totals, category spend, and limits.

description: Backend API for the household expense tracker. Owns expenses and categories: create/edit/delete expenses (any household member may modify any expense), create/edit/delete categories, compute daily/weekly/monthly totals, per-category totals, and category limit status. An expense logged in a currency other than USD is converted to USD via ExchangeRate-API using the historical rate on the expense's date; all totals and limits are computed in USD. Persists to expense-db. Does not send email/push notifications and does not handle sign-in itself — it validates the token the gateway forwards.
